era: 1711-1776 : 1711 生于爱丁堡一个没落的小贵族律师家庭，幼年丧父，由母亲抚养—1723 入爱丁堡大学（时年仅十二岁），家庭希望他学法律，他却迷上西塞罗与维吉尔—1726 离开大学未获学位，一度按家里安排尝试法律，据说神经衰弱到'学不动了'—1729 决意献身'思想与学问'，随即因过度用功而精神崩溃（ vitamins 与身体失调，两三年方愈）—1734 赴拉弗莱什（笛卡尔求学之地）隐居三年，以极低的食宿成本写《人性论》—1739-40 《人性论》三卷匿名出版于伦敦，'从印刷机上一生下来就死了'（他自嘲）—1745-46 任马拉凯侯爵（后为难民精神失常的安嫩代尔侯爵）的家庭教师，饱受屈辱—1746-48 随辛克莱将军赴大陆军事使团任秘书（维尔贝克战役亲历）—1748 改写《人性论》第一卷为《人类理解研究》出版，附'论奇迹'（著名的先验论证：任何证词都不可能证明奇迹）—1751 刊《道德原则研究》（把'是'与'应当'的裂缝推向伦理学，功利主义原则'效用'首次系统登场）—1752 刊《政治论丛》（货币数量论与国际价格机制'价格-铸币流动机制'的先驱表述），当选爱丁堡律师图书馆馆长，利用职权限额大量购书—1754-62 六卷《英格兰史》陆续出版，靠版税第一次真正致富，'史书的利润盖过了教堂的收成'—1757《宗教的自然史》—1763-65 任驻巴黎使馆秘书，后被赫特福德伯爵提携为代办，沙龙巨星，与卢梭交好后又闹翻（1766 护送卢梭赴英，卢梭偏执狂发作，公开指控休谟背信）—1767 任国务次官—1769 退隐爱丁堡新镇圣大卫街，'又能吃上一磅牛肉排'，成为'圣大卫街的胖大卫'—1775 肠胃出血（便血），诊断为'肠疾'，从容备后—1776 年 4 月与斯密长谈，嘱其身后发表《自然宗教对话录》与我的生平；8 月 25 日病逝，临终平静，坦然无神论者面对死亡，玻斯韦尔专程来探视期望'临终皈依'而大失所望；斯密在讣告信中写下那句著名评价：'接近于一个完全智慧和德性的人，也许达到了人性脆弱所能容许的最高程度'
era_en: 1711-1776 : born in Edinburgh to a minor gentry legal family, his father dead in his early childhood, raised by his mother - sent to the University of Edinburgh at twelve (1723), meant for the law but falling instead for Cicero and Virgil - left without a degree in 1726, tried law at his family's insistence, and reportedly broke down - resolved in 1729 to devote himself to 'thought and letters,' whereupon overstudy brought a nervous collapse that took years to mend - retired to La Flèche (Descartes's old school) in 1734 for three cheap years to write the Treatise of Human Nature - the Treatise published anonymously in London 1739-40, 'dead-born from the press' in his own words - tutor to the mad Marquess of Annandale 1745-46, a humiliation - secretary to General St Clair's embassies on the continent 1746-48, present at the raid on Lorient - the Philosophical Essays (later Enquiry Concerning Human Understanding) in 1748, with the essay on miracles and its a priori argument that no testimony can prove a miracle - the Enquiry Concerning the Principles of Morals in 1751, pushing the is-ought gap into ethics and giving utility its first systematic role - Political Discourses 1752 (the quantity theory of money and the price-specie-flow mechanism), elected Keeper of the Advocate's Library with its book-buying allowance - the History of England in six volumes 1754-62, which first made him truly rich, 'the copy-money given me for it much exceeded anything formerly known in England' - the Natural History of Religion 1757 - secretary, then chargé d'affaires, at the Paris embassy 1763-65, the lion of the salons, befriending and then quarrelling catastrophically with Rousseau, whom he escorted to England in 1766 only to be publicly accused of betrayal by Rousseau's persecution mania - Under-Secretary of State 1767 - retired to St David Street, Edinburgh in 1769, 'back to eating a pound of beefsteak,' the fat David Hume of the New Town - intestinal bleeding in 1775, diagnosed as disorder of the bowels - the long death: a calm April 1776 conversation with Adam Smith, arranging for Smith to publish the Dialogues Concerning Natural Religion and the posthumous My Own Life - died 25 August 1776, the serene infidel facing death without tremor; Boswell came hoping for a deathbed conversion and went away disappointed; Smith's obituary letter pronounced him 'approaching as nearly to the idea of a perfectly wise and virtuous man, as perhaps the nature of human frailty will permit'
school: 英国经验论的实际完成者 / 怀疑论与自然主义的'双面哲学家' / 史家与散文家（《英格兰史》）/ 经济学先驱（货币数量论）/ 宗教批判者（《自然宗教对话录》《宗教的自然史》）
historical_significance: 休谟（1711-1776），苏格兰启蒙运动的巨人，经验论在他手里走到尽头并撞碎了自身：把洛克'观念溯源'与培根'排除归纳'推到底，得到的是怀疑论而非确定性的完工证书。他把经验论变照妖镜的两记重锤——归纳问题（'太阳明天会升起'没有任何理性证明，只是习惯）与因果问题（我们从未观察到'必然联系'，只观察到恒常联结）——至今仍是哲学系新生考试的第一题。他抹平观念与印象的鸿沟，让'人性科学'（the science of man）成为一切科学的地基：逻辑、伦理、美学、政治都不过是人性的不同部门。他给理性限权（'理性是并且只应当是激情的奴隶'），给习俗正名（'习惯是人生的伟大指南'），用 is 与 ought 的裂缝给伦理学设了界碑，用'奇迹证词永远弱于自然齐一性'给神学设了禁线。他同时是实践家：外交官、图书馆馆长、六卷《英格兰史》作者、货币数量论先驱、亚当·斯密的挚友与引路人。他最伟大的作品也许是他的死法——一个公开的无神论者，从容、幽默、毫无恐惧地死去，让整个基督教欧洲看到'不信神的人如何面对终点'。康德说休谟'把我从独断的迷梦中唤醒'——全部德国古典哲学，起点竟是这位爱丁堡胖先生的一记叩门。
historical_significance_en: David Hume (1711-1776), giant of the Scottish Enlightenment, carried empiricism to its end and watched it shatter on its own conclusions: push Locke's tracing of ideas and Bacon's eliminationist induction to the limit and what arrives is not the certificate of certainty but skepticism. His two hammer-blows that turned empiricism into a demon-revealing mirror—the problem of induction ('the sun will rise tomorrow' has no rational proof, only habit) and the problem of causation (we never observe 'necessary connexion,' only constant conjunction)—are still the first examination questions of every philosophy freshman. He collapsed the distance between ideas and impressions and made the science of man the foundation of every other science: logic, morals, criticism, and politics are but branches of human nature. He limited reason ('reason is, and ought only to be the slave of the passions'), vindicated custom ('custom is the great guide of human life'), set the boundary-stone of ethics with the gap between is and ought, and closed theology's frontier with the argument that no testimony for a miracle can ever outweigh the uniformity of nature. He was also a man of affairs: diplomat, library keeper, author of the six-volume History of England, pioneer of the quantity theory of money, friend and midwife of Adam Smith. His greatest work may be his death—the public infidel dying serenely, wittily, without fear, showing all believing Europe how an unbeliever faces the end. Kant said Hume 'interrupted my dogmatic slumber'—the whole of German classical philosophy begins with a knock on the door from this fat gentleman of Edinburgh.
unique_thinking: 他的方法是双面的：怀疑论的手术刀加上自然主义的解剖台——先用最彻底的怀疑拆掉一切'理性基础'（因果、归纳、自我、奇迹、外在世界），然后不宣布灾难，而是问'既然如此，人实际是怎样活的'，给出自然主义的答案（习惯、情感、同情、习俗）。这双面动作的关键是'描述优先于辩护'：他从不问'我们应相信什么才配得上理性'，而问'信念实际上是怎样在人心里长出来的'——把规范问题改写为心理发生学问题。三个标志性动作：其一，概念清源——一切观念必须还原为印象（感觉与反省的原始材料），还原不出的（'必然联系''自我''实体'）宣布为无内容的幻影；其二，心理解释替代形而上辩护——因果信念不靠理性而靠习惯性联想，这不证明信念对，只解释信念从哪来；其三，缓和怀疑论（mitigated skepticism）——彻底的怀疑既不可能也活不下去，怀疑的正当用途是给一切断言'限权'：数学与经验科学保留（但根基是习惯而非理性），神学与独断形而上学出局。代价与极限：他自己的规范体系（正义、财产、承诺的惯例论）也建立在被他自己掏空了根基的习惯之上——他知道这一点并称之为'人生的伟大指南'，这个自我指涉的裂缝由康德接手。他把'人'变成了哲学的中心问题：哲学从此不再从世界或上帝出发，而从人性出发。
unique_thinking_en: His method was double-faced: the scalpel of skepticism mounted on the dissecting table of naturalism—first demolish every 'foundation of reason' with the most thorough doubt (causation, induction, self, miracles, the external world), then, instead of announcing catastrophe, ask how human beings actually live, and answer naturalistically (habit, sentiment, sympathy, custom). The hinge of the double move is description before justification: he never asks what we ought to believe to deserve the name of reason, but how belief actually grows in the human mind—rewriting normative questions as genetic psychology. Three signature moves. First, conceptual clarification: every idea must be resolvable into impressions (the raw material of sensation and reflection); what does not resolve—'necessary connexion,' the 'self,' substance—is declared a phantom without content. Second, psychological explanation in place of metaphysical justification: causal belief rests not on reason but on habitual association; this does not prove the belief true, it explains where the belief comes from. Third, mitigated skepticism: total doubt is impossible and unlivable; the proper use of doubt is to limit the jurisdiction of every claim—mathematics and empirical science survive (on the foundation of habit, not reason), theology and dogmatic metaphysics are dismissed. The cost and limit: his own normative system (justice, property, promise as conventions of artifice) also stands on the very habits whose foundations he had himself hollowed out—he knew this and called custom 'the great guide of human life,' and that self-referential crack was handed on to Kant. He made 'the human' the central question of philosophy: philosophy thenceforth starts not from the world or from God, but from human nature.

name_zh: 认识论/一切观念必须还原为其来源的印象，还原不出的概念宣布为无内容的幻影
name_en: epistemology/resolve every idea into the impressions it copies; what resolves to nothing is a phantom without content
category: 认识论/一切观念必须还原为其来源的印象，还原不出的概念宣布为无内容的幻影
modes.domain_zh: 《人类理解研究》第二节起：'我们全部观念中没有一个不能还原为感觉与反省的'——把洛克的双章验印升级为还原测试
modes.domain_en: From section II of the Enquiry: 'there is not one of all our ideas that does not resolve into sensation and reflection'—Locke's two-seal audit upgraded into a full reduction test
modes.definition_zh: 休谟把洛克'观念要能溯源'的审计升级为一条铁律：一切心灵内容分为两级——印象（感觉与反省的直接材料，鲜明而强烈）与观念（印象的摹本，微弱而模糊）；每个合格的观念都必须能指出它拷贝自哪个印象，指出不来的就是'无意义的'。他的著名试验：问一个从未吃过菠萝的人'菠萝的味道'是什么观念——他什么也没有，因为拷贝的母本不存在。这把剪刀接下来剪向三个哲学明星概念：'必然联系'（我们只观察到事件恒常相随，从未有'必然'的印象；所谓必然联系只是心中习惯连接的感觉）、'自我'（内省只能捉到一束流动的知觉，从未捉到'自我'这个单一印象）、'实体'（我们只有一束性质，没有承载性质的'基底'印象）。深意在于：这不是否定世界，而是给语言发驾照——一个词要合法上路，必须出示它的印象牌照；拿不出牌照的词（无论多么古老、多么庄严）只能进报废场。这是维特根斯坦'对不可说的保持沉默'与逻辑实证主义'可证实性原则'的先声。代价：还原原则自身无法被还原为印象（它是规则不是印象），休谟对此自觉——他说这是'人性科学的牛顿式公设'而非被证明的定理，而这条自我指涉的裂缝后来由康德与实用主义分别接手。现代对应物：操作主义（心理学变量的操作化定义）、语义学的指称测试、需求文档的'可观测验收标准'、以及一切'先给概念找可观察的锚，再允许它进入推理'的纪律。
modes.definition_en: Hume upgraded Locke's 'trace your ideas' audit into an iron law: all contents of the mind fall into two ranks—impressions (the immediate materials of sensation and reflection, vivid and forceful) and ideas (faint copies of impressions); every admissible idea must name the impression it copies, and what cannot is 'insignificant.' His famous experiment: ask a man who has never tasted a pineapple for the idea of its taste—he has none, because the master-copy does not exist. The scissors then go after three philosophical celebrities: 'necessary connexion' (we observe only constant succession of events, never an impression of 'necessity'; the felt necessity is a habit of the mind), the 'self' (introspection catches only a flowing bundle of perceptions, never a single impression of self), and 'substance' (we have a bundle of qualities, no impression of the substratum that bears them). The deeper point: this does not deny the world—it issues driver's licenses to language: a word may lawfully enter reasoning only by showing its impression license; without one, however ancient and solemn, the word goes to the scrapyard. It was the ancestor of Wittgenstein's silence about the unsayable and logical positivism's verifiability principle. The cost: the reduction principle itself cannot be reduced to an impression (it is a rule, not an impression); Hume knew this—calling it a Newtonian postulate of the science of man rather than a proven theorem—and the self-referential crack was taken up later by Kant and pragmatism. Modern analogues: operationalism (operationally defining psychological variables), referential tests in semantics, observable acceptance criteria in requirements documents—every discipline that anchors a concept to something observable before admitting it into inference.
modes.source_chapter: 《人性论》卷一.1.1（观念与印象的复制原则）；《人类理解研究》第二节（观念的来源与'缺印象检验'）；《人性论》卷一.4.6（论人格同一性：自我是知觉束）
modes.key_quote_zh: 当我们怀疑一个哲学名词是否有意义时，只需追问：它来自哪个印象？拿不出母本的词，再庄严也只是空响。
modes.key_quote_en: When we doubt whether a philosophical term has meaning, we need only ask: from what impression is it derived? A word with no master-copy, however solemn, is an empty sound.
process_zh: 冻结术语：列出论证中承担重量的关键词，禁止未检验的词继续参与推理
找母本：对每个词追问'我关于它的印象是什么'——何时何地、通过哪个感官、强度如何
降解拆分：复杂观念拆到最简单位，逐个核对各自的印象来源
裁决注销：有母本的词合法保留；母本残缺的降级为情感表达；完全没有的注销出局
改写论证：用幸存的词重建论证，被注销概念所承担的结论必须另行论证或放弃
process_en: Freeze the terms: list the words doing weight-bearing work in the argument; no unexamined word continues in inference
Find the master-copy: for each word ask what impression it comes from—when, where, through which sense, how vivid
Decompose: break complex ideas into simples and check each one's impression source
Adjudicate: words with master-copies stay lawful; partial ones are demoted to expressions of feeling; the copyless are written off
Rebuild: reconstruct the argument with surviving words; conclusions that leaned on written-off concepts must be reargued or abandoned
representative_cases_zh: 菠萝试验：从未尝过菠萝的人对'菠萝味'没有观念——休谟用它演示'复杂观念若缺原始印象即不可能'，这成为经验论教科书的第一实验
对'必然联系'的还原：火与热恒常相随的观察之外，我们从未有'火必然生热'的印象——'必然'一词被注销出客观世界，只以主观习惯感的形式存活
对'自我'的内省搜索：'每当我深入我所谓的自我，总是捉到某个冷热明暗的爱憎知觉，从未捉到没有知觉的自我'——人格同一性被改写为一束知觉与记忆的编织物
法庭上的'证据无来源'：证人声称'感觉到被告的恶意'，而可采证据只有行为观察——'恶意'作为不可观察的心理实体被降级为推断而非事实
representative_cases_en: The pineapple test: one who has never tasted a pineapple has no idea of its taste—Hume's demonstration that complex ideas are impossible without original impressions, the first experiment of empiricism textbooks

The reduction of 'necessary connexion': beyond the constant succession of fire and heat we never have an impression that fire must produce heat—the word 'necessity' is written off the objective world, surviving only as the subjective feel of habit

The introspective search for the 'self': 'whenever I enter most intimately into what I call myself, I always stumble on some particular perception, of heat or cold, love or hatred—I never catch a self without a perception'—personal identity rewritten as a bundle woven of perceptions and memory

Evidence without a source at trial: a witness claims to 'perceive the defendant's malice,' while admissible evidence is only observed behavior—'malice' as an unobservable mental entity demoted from fact to inference
modern_applications_zh: 产品指标设计：'用户忠诚度'不可直接观测，必须先操作化为可测代理（复购率/NPS/留存曲线）再进仪表盘——印象拷贝法的分析版
心理量表编制：构念（如'焦虑'）必须先给出可观察的指标集，否则量表测的是'词语的幻影'
合同与需求文档：'合理''尽快''显著'等词要么给出可核验标准，要么明示为主观判断条款——语义驾照制度
AI 可解释性：解释模型判断时区分'有数据母本的归因'（特征重要度）与'无母本的修辞'（'模型认为它很重要'）
modern_applications_en: Metric design in products: 'user loyalty' is not directly observable—operationalize it into proxies (repurchase rate, NPS, retention curves) before it enters the dashboard: the analyst's impression-copy
Psychometric scale construction: a construct such as 'anxiety' must first specify its observable indicator set, or the scale measures a phantom of words
Contracts and requirement documents: 'reasonable,' 'promptly,' 'significant' must either carry verifiable standards or be marked as subjective clauses—a licensing regime for language
AI explainability: distinguish attributions with data-backed masters (feature importance) from rhetoric without one ('the model felt it mattered')

representative_figures.relation_zh: 直接前驱：双章验印（感觉/反省）是印象拷贝法的半成品，休谟把审计升级为还原测试
representative_figures.relation_en: direct predecessor: the two-seal audit of sensation and reflection is the half-built version; Hume upgraded audit into reduction

representative_figures.relation_zh: 二十世纪传人：'对不可说的保持沉默'是缺印象注销令的语言哲学重铸
representative_figures.relation_en: twentieth-century heir: silence about the unsayable is the write-off of the copyless, recast in philosophy of language

representative_figures.relation_zh: 操作主义旗手：把'概念等于其测量操作'立为物理学纪律——印象拷贝法的实验室版
representative_figures.relation_en: champion of operationalism: a concept just is its measurement operations—impression-copy for the laboratory

name_zh: 方法论/因果'必然性'从未被观察到——我们只有恒常联结与习惯性期待，不给因果断言超出观察的凭证
name_en: methodology/causal 'necessity' is never observed—we have only constant conjunction and habitual expectation; grant causal claims no credential beyond observation
category: 方法论/因果'必然性'从未被观察到——我们只有恒常联结与习惯性期待，不给因果断言超出观察的凭证
modes.domain_zh: 《人性论》卷一.3.14：'当我们审视两个对象间所谓的因果联系时，只发现一件事：A 之后 B 恒常出现——我们从未观察到任何把二者绑在一起的必然纽带'
modes.domain_en: Treatise I.3.14: 'when we look about us towards the objects of human knowledge, we find one thing only: B has constantly followed A—we never observe any necessary tie binding them'
modes.definition_zh: 休谟对因果的分析是哲学史上最著名的一次'拆弹'：当我们说'A 导致 B'时，我们实际观察到的只有三件事——A 与 B 在时空上接近、A 先于 B、二者恒常联结。'必然联系'这个第四项从未出现于观察：台球相撞，我们看到球动，看不到'使它动'的力本身。他再追问：那因果信念从哪来？答案是从习惯——反复经历 A 后 B，心灵在看到 A 时自动预期 B，这种'习惯性过渡的感觉'被误当作外部世界的必然结构。深意在于：他把因果从'世界的形而上骨架'降级为'心灵的习惯预期'，这不证明因果不存在，只证明因果没有我们以为的那种理性凭证——科学与常识照样运转，但运转的理由是习惯而非证明。这是'信念的心理学发生学'取代'信念的形而上辩护'的奠基时刻。操作上，休谟的怀疑不是瘫痪剂而是校准器：因果断言的强度应与'恒常联结的广度与严格度'成正比，与'替代解释的数量'成反比——观察证据越厚，越可倚重；越薄，越该存疑。代价：把'必然'逐出世界后，科学定律也只剩'迄今恒常'的地位，科学从'必然真理'降为'最可靠的预期'——很多科学家不接受这个降级（康德为此重新发明了先天）。现代对应物：相关不等于因果的统计学纪律、随机对照试验作为'制造恒常联结'的技术、Granger 因果与反事实框架、以及一切'因果主张必须标注证据等级'的证据医学。
modes.definition_en: Hume's analysis of causation is philosophy's most famous defusal: when we say 'A causes B,' all we ever observe is three things—A and B are contiguous, A precedes B, and the pair is constantly conjoined. 'Necessary connexion,' the supposed fourth item, never appears in observation: at the colliding billiard balls we see the second move, but not the force 'making it move.' He then asks where causal belief comes from: from habit—after repeated experience of B following A, the mind automatically expects B upon seeing A, and this feeling of habitual transition is mistaken for a necessary structure of the world. The deeper point: he demoted causation from the metaphysical skeleton of the world to the mind's habitual expectation—this does not prove causation absent, only that causation lacks the rational credential we assumed; science and common sense run on as before, but on habit, not proof. It was the founding moment of belief's genetic psychology displacing belief's metaphysical justification. Operationally, Hume's skepticism is a calibrator, not a paralyzer: the strength of a causal claim should scale with the breadth and rigor of its constant conjunctions and scale inversely with the number of rival explanations—the thicker the observational evidence, the more you may lean on it; the thinner, the more you should doubt. The cost: with 'necessity' expelled, laws of nature too are left with the status of 'constant so far'—science demoted from necessary truth to most reliable expectation, a demotion many scientists refused (Kant reinvented the a priori on its behalf). Modern analogues: the statistical discipline that correlation is not causation, randomized controlled trials as the technology for manufacturing constant conjunctions, Granger causality and counterfactual frameworks—every regime that grades causal claims by their evidence.
modes.source_chapter: 《人性论》卷一.3.2-3.14（因果推理的全程解剖：接近、接续、恒常联结、习惯过渡）；《人类理解研究》第七节（'论必然联系的观念'）
key_concepts: 接近-接续-恒常联结三要素
因果信念的心理学发生学
modes.key_quote_zh: 我们从任何单个事例中，都观察不到把原因与结果绑在一起的必然纽带——纽带在我们心里，不在台球之间。
modes.key_quote_en: From a single instance we never observe the necessary tie that binds cause to effect—the tie is in our minds, not between the billiard balls.
process_zh: 拆解断言：把'X 导致 Y'拆成可观察成分——接近、先后、恒常联结是否都有证据
找必然项：追问断言中'必然/一定/永远'的凭证是什么——任何观察都提供不了它
解释发生：检查自己的因果确信从何而来——真实证据还是反复曝光的习惯感
列替代解释：为同一恒常联结列出竞争假说（混杂、反向、共同原因、巧合）
按证据定强度：把因果确信度校准为联结的广度与严格度的函数，并随新证据再校准
process_en: Decompose the claim: break 'X causes Y' into observables—do contiguity, precedence, and constant conjunction each have evidence
Hunt the necessity: ask what credentials 'necessarily/always/invariably' carry—no observation supplies them
Explain the genesis: check where your causal confidence actually comes from—real evidence or the habit of repeated exposure
List rivals: for the same conjunction, enumerate rival hypotheses (confounders, reverse causation, common cause, coincidence)
Calibrate: set causal confidence as a function of the breadth and rigor of the conjunction, recalibrating as evidence accrues
representative_cases_zh: 台球解剖（《人性论》卷一.3.2）：第一球撞第二球，我们观察到的只有相触与球动——'传递之力'从未登场；这是因果怀疑论的原初教学案例
对'白天导致黑夜'的封堵：昼夜恒常联结数千年，但休谟会指出这只是接续而非因果（共同原因是地球自转）——恒常联结的解释需竞争假说筛选
他自己的货币观察：《政治论丛》中'美洲金银流入导致欧洲物价上涨'正是因果怀疑法的正面运用——以多处独立的恒常联结（法、英、荷）交叉锁定因果
医学史上的放血疗法：两千年的'放血后康复'恒常联结从未被追问替代解释（自愈、选择偏差）——19 世纪对照统计引入后即崩塌
representative_cases_en: The billiard-ball anatomy (Treatise I.3.2): one ball strikes another; we observe contact and motion—the 'transferred force' never appears; the primal teaching case of causal skepticism

Blocking 'day causes night': the conjunction is millennia old, yet Hume would note it is mere succession (the common cause is Earth's rotation)—constant conjunctions must be filtered through rival hypotheses

His own monetary observation: in the Political Discourses, 'the influx of American bullion raised European prices' is causal skepticism applied positively—cross-locking the cause through independent constant conjunctions in France, England, and Holland

Bloodletting in medical history: two millennia of 'bled, then recovered' conjunctions never asked for rival explanations (natural recovery, selection bias)—the edifice collapsed the moment controlled statistics arrived in the nineteenth century
modern_applications_zh: 数据分析：任何'某功能导致留存提升'的结论，必须先过三关——混杂排除、时间先后可证、机制有独立证据；过不了的降级为相关
投资研究：把'利好后上涨'的叙事强制拆解为恒常联结样本 + 替代解释清单，禁止用一次案例讲因果故事
医疗决策：循证医学证据分级正是因果怀疑法的制度化——'专家认为'排在'对照试验'之后，因为习惯感不是证据
组织复盘：事故归因时禁止'最后一次变更就是原因'（单纯接续），要求列出所有同期间的变更再逐一排除
modern_applications_en: Data analysis: any 'feature X lifted retention' conclusion must pass three gates—confounders excluded, precedence demonstrable, mechanism independently evidenced; failing these, demote to correlation
Investment research: force 'good news, then rally' narratives into a sample of conjunctions plus a list of rival explanations; no causal stories from single episodes
Medical decisions: evidence-based medicine's grading is causal skepticism institutionalized—'expert opinion' ranks below controlled trials, because the feel of habit is not evidence
Organizational postmortems: forbid 'the last change was the cause' (mere succession); list every concurrent change and eliminate them one by one

representative_figures.relation_zh: 正面回应者：'被休谟唤醒'后以先天综合为因果重新颁发理性凭证——因果怀疑法的最伟大对手
representative_figures.relation_en: the great respondent: awakened by Hume, he re-issued causation's rational credential via synthetic a priori—the great antagonist

representative_figures.relation_zh: 方法内化者：求同求异法把'恒常联结的筛选'写成形式规则——怀疑法的方法论定装
representative_figures.relation_en: internalizer: his canons of agreement and difference formalize the filtering of conjunctions—the method armed into logic

representative_figures.relation_zh: 现代技术化者：以因果图与反事实框架量化'何时可谈因果'——休谟问题的算法解法
representative_figures.relation_en: modern formalizer: causal graphs and counterfactuals quantify when causal talk is licensed—an algorithmic answer to Hume

name_zh: 元方法/从'迄今恒常'推不出'未来必然'——归纳没有理性证明，只有心理依据；一切预测须自带这一限界声明
name_en: meta-method/no inference from 'constant so far' to 'necessarily henceforth'—induction has no rational proof, only psychological warrant; every forecast ships with this boundary stated
category: 元方法/从'迄今恒常'推不出'未来必然'——归纳没有理性证明，只有心理依据；一切预测须自带这一限界声明
modes.domain_zh: 《人类理解研究》第四节：'太阳明天会升起'这个命题，其明确性与'它不会升起'同样可以理解——没有任何理性论证能在二者之间裁决
modes.domain_en: Enquiry section IV: 'that the sun will not rise tomorrow is no less intelligible a proposition, nor implies more contradiction, than the affirmation that it will rise'—no rational argument can adjudicate between them
modes.definition_zh: 归纳问题是休谟留给哲学最锋利的遗产：一切关于未来的推理要么是演绎（前提真则结论必然真），要么是归纳（从已观察推未观察）。演绎推不出未来（'未来类似过去'不是逻辑真理，否定它不产生矛盾）；而用归纳证明归纳（'过去归纳有效，所以未来归纳也有效'）是循环论证。结论：归纳没有任何理性证明——不是休谟找到了它的缺陷，而是他证明了这个'证明'这个类目本身为空。深意在于：他不是要废除科学，而是给一切预测打上结构性水印：任何从过去推未来的主张都是'以习惯为担保的预期'，其可信度来自经验的厚度而非逻辑的强制。这催生了他自己的缓和结论——继续用归纳，但认清它的凭证种类：'习惯是人生的伟大指南'，指南不是证明，是可靠的仆人而非立法者。操作规则：预测必须携带三件套——基础数据的时间跨度、'过去类似'假设的明确声明、失效条件（什么样的新观察会推翻外推）。代价：彻底接受限界会让'确定性'从科学词汇中消失，许多实践者因此宁可不读休谟；而把限界声明格式化（置信区间、先验分布、情景分析）是现代科学对他的无声采纳。现代对应物：统计推断的置信与显著性语言、机器学习的泛化误差与分布漂移警告、天气预报的概率化表述、以及一切'预测必附失效条件'的风控纪律。
modes.definition_en: The problem of induction is Hume's sharpest bequest to philosophy: inference about the future is either deductive (if premises true, conclusion necessarily true) or inductive (from observed to unobserved). Deduction cannot reach the future ('the future resembles the past' is no logical truth; its denial is no contradiction); and proving induction by induction ('induction has worked, so it will work') is circular. Conclusion: induction has no rational proof—not that Hume found its flaw, but that he proved the category 'proof' empty here. The deeper point: he did not abolish science; he watermarked every prediction with a structural disclaimer—any claim from past to future is 'an expectation guaranteed by habit,' its credibility from the thickness of experience, not the compulsion of logic. This generates his own mitigated conclusion—keep using induction, but know what kind of credential it holds: 'custom is the great guide of human life'; a guide is not a proof, a reliable servant rather than a legislator. Operational rule: every forecast must carry three items—the time-span of the underlying data, an explicit statement of the 'future-resembles-past' assumption, and failure conditions (what new observation would overturn the extrapolation). The cost: accepting the boundary fully banishes 'certainty' from the scientific vocabulary, and many practitioners prefer not to read Hume; formalizing the disclaimer—confidence intervals, priors, scenario analysis—is modern science's silent adoption of him. Modern analogues: the language of confidence and significance in statistical inference, generalization error and distribution-shift warnings in machine learning, probabilistic weather forecasts, and every risk discipline that requires failure conditions attached to predictions.
modes.source_chapter: 《人类理解研究》第四、五节（归纳的两难与'习惯性联想'的解答）；《人性论》卷一.3.6（'未来类似过去'无证明）；《人性论》卷一.3.12（概率与证据的强弱比较）
key_concepts: 未来类似过去（假设非定理）
预测的三件套（跨度/假设/失效条件）
modes.key_quote_zh: 自然不向理性出示未来的支票——我们所能做的，是把习惯开出的预期如实标注为预期。
modes.key_quote_en: Nature does not show reason a check for the future—the most we can do is label the expectation habit issues as exactly what it is, an expectation.
process_zh: 识别归纳步：找出论证中从'已观察'跳到'未观察'的那一步，明确写出它
检查凭证：追问这一步的担保是演绎、还是经验的厚度——演绎担保必为假（查循环）
声明假设：把'未来类似过去/样本代表总体'显式写成前提，不许它隐藏
标注失效条件：写明什么新证据将推翻外推——没有失效条件的预测是信仰不是科学
按厚度定信心：以基础数据的跨度、多样性、稳定性校准结论的置信表述
process_en: Spot the inductive step: locate the leap from observed to unobserved and write it out explicitly
Check the credential: ask whether the step is guaranteed by deduction or by the thickness of experience; a deductive guarantee must be circular—verify
Declare the assumption: write 'future resembles past / sample represents population' as an explicit premise; let it not hide
State failure conditions: spell out what new evidence would overturn the extrapolation—a forecast without them is faith, not science
Grade confidence by thickness: calibrate the confidence of the conclusion to the span, variety, and stability of the underlying data
representative_cases_zh: 太阳问题（1748）：'太阳明升'与'太阳明不升'同样可理解、无逻辑矛盾——归纳不可证明的原初陈述，至今仍是哲学系第一考题
休谟自己的史书写作：《英格兰史》拒绝'历史有方向'的目的论，只按证据讲'发生了什么'——把归纳限界内化为史学方法论
其《政治论丛》的货币预测：'金银增加最终提高物价但有时滞'—— prediction 附带机制与滞后条件，是带失效条件的归纳外推范本
1929 年前的华尔街：'股价长期上涨'建立在无失效条件的归纳外推上——1929-33 年的崩塌正是'未来类似过去'假设失效的教科书样本
representative_cases_en: The sunrise question (1748): 'the sun will rise tomorrow' is as intelligible and contradiction-free as its denial—the primal statement of induction's unprovability, still the first examination question of philosophy
His own historiography: the History of England refuses teleology, telling only 'what happened' on the evidence—the induction boundary internalized as historical method
His monetary forecasts in the Political Discourses: 'more bullion finally raises prices, with a lag'—a mechanism with lag conditions attached, the model of extrapolation with failure conditions
Wall Street before 1929: 'stocks rise in the long run' rested on extrapolation without failure conditions; the crash of 1929-33 is the textbook case of the 'future resembles past' assumption failing
modern_applications_zh: 量化投资：回测报告必须声明'样本期外不保证'并给出失效条件（政策变化、流动性结构改变）——归纳限界的合规化
机器学习部署：模型卡强制标注训练分布与部署分布的差异警告，分布漂移即触发重训——'习惯失效检测'的自动化
商业计划：预测附'本预测假设未来 N 年无 X 级冲击'，并季度复检假设——把'未来类似过去'从隐藏前提升格为受审条目
科学传播：天气预报说'降水概率 70%'而非'明天有雨'——概率化表述是限界法对公众的让步也是诚实
modern_applications_en: Quantitative finance: backtest reports must state 'no guarantee out of sample' with failure conditions (policy shifts, liquidity regime changes)—the compliance form of the induction boundary
ML deployment: model cards must flag training/deployment distribution gaps, with retraining triggered by drift—automated habit-failure detection
Business planning: forecasts carry 'this assumes no X-class shock for N years,' reviewed quarterly—raising 'future resembles past' from hidden premise to audited item
Science communication: '70% chance of rain' rather than 'it will rain tomorrow'—probabilistic phrasing is the boundary method made honest for the public

representative_figures.relation_zh: 激进化继承者：以'归纳不存在，只有证伪'把休谟限界推为科学划界标准
representative_figures.relation_en: radicalizing heir: 'there is no induction, only falsification'—Hume's boundary hardened into a demarcation of science

representative_figures.relation_zh: 概率论回应者：以《概率论》给不确定推理建形式逻辑——为归纳限界造计量工具
representative_figures.relation_en: probabilistic respondent: his Treatise on Probability builds a formal logic of uncertain inference—metrology for the boundary

representative_figures.relation_zh: 实用主义收编者：以'人类看重的不是真理而是可行动'回应休谟——归纳限界的决策论改写
representative_figures.relation_en: pragmatic absorbent: man values action over truth—Hume's boundary rewritten as decision theory

name_zh: 实践观/习惯是人生的伟大指南——承认理性推不出确定性后，把习惯从'理性之敌'转正为'信念的合法来源'并管理它
name_en: praxis/custom is the great guide of human life—once reason yields no certainty, promote custom from reason's enemy to belief's lawful source, and manage it
category: 实践观/习惯是人生的伟大指南——承认理性推不出确定性后，把习惯从'理性之敌'转正为'信念的合法来源'并管理它
modes.domain_zh: 《人性论》卷一.3.8 与《人类理解研究》第五节：'一切从经验得来的推理，其结果都不是理性所理解的那种必然，而是习惯使然的联想'
modes.domain_en: Treatise I.3.8 and Enquiry section V: 'all inferences from experience are not consequences of reasoning but associations made by custom'
modes.definition_zh: 休谟哲学最反直觉的一步：拆掉理性的宝座之后，他没有宣布虚无，而是给长期被理性主义贬为'谬误之源'的习惯发了正式任命书。习惯不是知识的耻辱，而是知识的唯一工作引擎——婴儿靠它学会世界，科学家靠它提出假设，社会靠它运转。深意在于：这是对'理性至上'的哥白尼式倒转——决定信念的不是论证的强度而是心理的惯性，这不是应然（ought）的控诉，而是实然（is）的描述；聪明的做法不是假装理性在驾驶，而是承认习惯在驾驶、然后管理驾驶员：选择让心灵反复暴露在什么样的经验里（这决定养成什么习惯）、为高危习惯设置理性检票口（在'习惯自动给出答案'与'行动'之间插入复核）、识别习惯失效的场景（环境改变时旧联想成为陷阱）。休谟自己就是这个方法的活标本：他的写作习惯（每天上午写作、下午社交、傍晚晚餐）、他的商业习惯（版税与出版的精确计算）、他的社交习惯（沙龙与餐桌上的声名经营）——他把'人生的伟大指南'过成了可审计的日程表。代价：习惯可被操纵——宣传、成瘾与算法推荐正是'喂什么经验养什么习惯'的恶意版本，休谟没有预见到注意力工业；而习惯管理若没有元层面的自省，管理本身就沦为另一套习惯。现代对应物：行为设计学（习惯回路）、'环境设计优于意志力'的自我管理、组织流程的'习惯化 vs 复盘'双轨制、以及算法推荐系统的伦理审计。
modes.definition_en: The most counterintuitive step in Hume's philosophy: having toppled reason's throne, he announces not nihilism but a formal appointment for custom—long demoted by rationalism as the source of error—as the sole working engine of knowledge: the infant learns the world by it, the scientist proposes hypotheses by it, society runs by it. The deeper point is a Copernican inversion of reason's supremacy: what fixes belief is not argument's strength but psychological inertia—and this is not an accusation of what ought to be but a description of what is; the wise course is not to pretend reason drives, but to admit habit drives and then manage the driver: choose which experiences the mind is repeatedly exposed to (this is what breeds which habits), insert a rational ticket-gate between 'habit's automatic answer' and 'action' in high-stakes cases, and identify where habit fails (when environments change, old associations become traps). Hume himself was the method's living specimen: his writing habit (mornings at the desk, afternoons in company, dinner at evening), his commercial habit (the precise accounting of royalties and editions), his social habit (repute managed in salons and at table)—he lived 'the great guide of human life' as an auditable timetable. The cost: habit can be manipulated—propaganda, addiction, and algorithmic recommendation are malicious versions of 'feed experiences, breed habits,' an attention industry Hume never foresaw; and habit management without meta-level self-inspection degenerates into another habit. Modern analogues: behavior design (habit loops), 'environment design over willpower' self-management, the dual track of institutionalized habit versus retrospective in organizations, and the ethics audit of recommender systems.
modes.source_chapter: 《人性论》卷一.3.8（习惯对推理的解释）；《人类理解研究》第五节第一部分（'习惯是人生的伟大指南'）；《人性论》卷三.2（习俗与社会秩序的自然生长）
key_concepts: 习惯是人生的伟大指南
管理驾驶员而非更换驾驶员
modes.key_quote_zh: 习惯是人生的伟大指南——既然理性开不出确定性的处方，就承认这位老司机，然后管好他。
modes.key_quote_en: Custom is the great guide of human life—reason writes no prescription of certainty, so acknowledge the old driver, and manage him.
process_zh: 承认惯性：接受'我的大部分信念由重复曝光而非论证决定'这一实然
盘点驾驶员：列出当前主导决策的习惯，标注各自的养成经历与当前环境是否仍匹配
设计喂养：刻意选择暴露的经验源（读什么、见谁、做什么），以养出想要的习惯
设检票口：对高风险决策在'习惯给出答案'与'行动'之间强制插入理性复核
监控失效：环境变化时主动重跑旧联想，识别'曾经可靠现在是陷阱'的习惯并重新训练
process_en: Admit the inertia: accept that most of your beliefs are fixed by repeated exposure, not argument
Inventory the drivers: list the habits currently steering decisions, marking how each was bred and whether it still fits the environment
Design the feeding: deliberately choose the experiences you expose yourself to—what you read, whom you meet, what you do—to breed the habits you want
Set ticket gates: for high-stakes decisions, force a rational review between habit's answer and the action
Monitor failure: when environments shift, rerun old associations and retrain habits that were once reliable and are now traps
representative_cases_zh: 休谟的写作与生活作息：'我每天上午三小时写作，下午与朋友交往，傍晚六点晚餐'——他把习惯制度化到日程，以稳定的心境产出六卷史书
《人性论》'死产'之后的转向：休谟复盘'抽象哲学没有市场'，改写为浅显优美的《研究》——对'公众接受习惯'的顺应而非硬碰
他在爱丁堡律师图书馆馆长任上的阅读配给：利用购书限额系统性地喂自己经济与史料的经验——喂养设计的第一人称样本
法庭上的'目击证词不可靠'规则：反复出现的'目击者确信但错误'促使程序把'习惯性确信'与'证据'分开检票——习惯指南法的法律化
representative_cases_en: Hume's working timetable: 'I spend three hours every morning writing, afternoons with friends, dinner at six'—habit institutionalized into a schedule that steadied the moods producing six volumes of history

The pivot after the Treatise 'fell dead-born': Hume audited that 'abstract philosophy found no market' and recast it as the graceful, accessible Enquiries—accommodating the public's reading habits rather than butting against them
His reading rations as Keeper of the Advocate's Library: spending the book allowance to feed himself systematically with economics and sources—the first-person specimen of feeding design

The courtroom rule that eyewitness confidence is unreliable: recurrent 'certain but wrong' witnesses forced procedure to check 'habitual confidence' and 'evidence' at separate gates—custom-as-guide legislated
modern_applications_zh: 个人效率：用'固定时间+固定地点+固定启动仪式'绑定写作/训练习惯，让环境而非意志力承担坚持成本
产品增长：习惯回路（触发-行动-奖励-投入）的设计即'喂养设计'的商业化——同时引出伦理边界问题
组织管理：新流程先强制跑 90 天养成组织习惯，再开放复盘调整——避免'天天改流程'使习惯无法沉淀
自我改进：每周审计'我的三个判断中哪些是习惯说话'——给驾驶员装行车记录仪
modern_applications_en: Personal productivity: bind writing or training to fixed time, place, and initiation ritual—let environment, not willpower, carry the cost of persistence
Product growth: the habit loop (trigger-action-reward-investment) is feeding design commercialized—and raises the ethical boundary question
Organizational management: run a new process for ninety days to let the habit settle before opening it to retrospective—daily rewrites leave nothing to sediment
Self-improvement: audit weekly which of three judgments were habit speaking—install the driver's dashcam

representative_figures.relation_zh: 心理学直系后裔：《心理学原理》的'习惯'章直接承接休谟——把习惯立为神经系统的经济法则
representative_figures.relation_en: direct heir in psychology: the habit chapter of the Principles takes Hume's custom as the nervous system's law of economy

representative_figures.relation_zh: 实用主义吸收者：'习惯即社会制度'把休谟的个人习惯扩展为共同体层面
representative_figures.relation_en: pragmatist absorber: 'habit is social institution' extends Hume's personal habit to the level of the community

representative_figures.relation_zh: 实验继任者：系统一/系统二把'习惯驾驶、理性检票'做成了实验科学
representative_figures.relation_en: experimental successor: System 1 and System 2 made 'habit drives, reason checks tickets' an experimental science

name_zh: 伦理观/理性不产生行动也不裁定目标——'理性是并且只应当是激情的奴隶'；说服与决策必须诉诸情感而非纯论证
name_en: ethics/reason neither produces action nor adjudicates ends—'reason is, and ought only to be, the slave of the passions'; persuasion and decision must address sentiment, not argument alone
category: 伦理观/理性不产生行动也不裁定目标——'理性是并且只应当是激情的奴隶'；说服与决策必须诉诸情感而非纯论证
modes.domain_zh: 《人性论》卷二.3.3：'理性是并且只应当是激情的奴隶，除了服务与服从激情之外，不能妄求任何其他职务'——道德赞责的最后根源是情感而非理性
modes.domain_en: Treatise II.3.3: 'reason is, and ought only to be, the slave of the passions, and can never pretend to any other office than to serve and obey them'—the ultimate root of moral praise and blame is sentiment, not reason
modes.definition_zh: 这句常被误读为'非理性主义'的话，实际是一次精密的职务重组：理性只有两个合法职能——判断观念关系（数学）与判断事实（经验）——它既不产生行动（行动的终极动力是欲求与情感），也不裁定目标（目标由激情设定，理性只设计达成路径）。'手段-目的'的分工就此定型：激情出目的，理性出路线图；理性可以纠正事实错误（'这条路不通向你想去的地方'），但无法推翻目的本身（'你不该想去那里'不是理性的判决）。深意在于：其一，这是对'人皆理性人'的政治学与经济学根基的釜底抽薪——休谟开启了后来行为经济学'人是有限理性情感动物'的整条路线；其二，它改写了说服技术——要改变行动，先改变情感与欲求，事实与逻辑只是服务通道；其三，它给道德哲学换地基：善恶不是理性发现的属性，而是情感的表达（'当你断言某行为是恶的，你只是在表达你对此的谴责之感'）。代价：若一切目标都源于激情，激情的可塑性与操纵性就成为核心政治问题——休谟深知此点，故他的政治写作从不诉诸纯论证，而是精于叙事、讽刺与例证的情感工程。现代对应物：行为经济学（损失厌恶、框架效应）、'叙事优于数据'的传播学、激励设计的'先问人要什么'、以及一切'先共情后说服'的沟通方法论。
modes.definition_en: The dictum so often misread as irrationalism is in fact a precise job reorganization: reason has only two lawful functions—judging relations of ideas (mathematics) and judging matters of fact (experience)—and it neither produces action (the ultimate springs of action are desire and sentiment) nor adjudicates ends (ends are set by the passions; reason only charts the routes). The means-ends division is thus fixed: the passions supply the ends, reason the roadmap; reason may correct factual error ('this road does not lead where you want') but cannot overthrow the end itself ('you ought not want it' is no verdict of reason). The deeper points: first, it undercuts the 'rational agent' foundation of politics and economics—Hume opens the whole route to behavioral economics's finite, sentimental agent; second, it rewrites the technology of persuasion—to change action, change sentiment and desire first; facts and logic are only the service channel; third, it re-lays moral philosophy's foundation: good and evil are not properties reason discovers but expressions of sentiment ('when you pronounce an action vicious, you mean nothing but that from the constitution of your nature you have a feeling of blame from the contemplation of it'). The cost: if all ends spring from passion, the malleability and manipulability of passion becomes the central political problem—Hume knew it, and his political writing never argues in the abstract; he excels at the emotional engineering of narrative, irony, and example. Modern analogues: behavioral economics (loss aversion, framing effects), 'narrative beats data' in communication studies, incentive design that asks first what people want, and every communication method that empathizes before persuading.
modes.source_chapter: 《人性论》卷二.3.3（理性与激情的职务划分）；卷三.1.1-1.2（道德区别源于情感而非理性；是-应当问题）；卷二.3.9（激情的直接影响原则）
key_concepts: 理性两职能（关系与事实）
modes.key_quote_zh: 理性是并且只应当是激情的奴隶——它开路，但选目的地的是心。
modes.key_quote_en: Reason is, and ought only to be, the slave of the passions—it charts the road, but the heart chooses the destination.
process_zh: 分离手段与目的：把决策拆为'要什么'（激情管辖）与'怎么去'（理性管辖），禁止两者互相越权
审计事实层：理性只在事实与手段层面纠错——检查前提与路径，不越权审判目标
直面情感：承认自己的目标源于欲求而非推理，把欲求本身作为审视对象而非遮掩它
说服先攻情感：要改变他人行为，先处理其情感、欲求与身份认同，再上事实与逻辑
管理激情生态：人的欲求可塑——设计自己的环境与叙事来养护良好欲求，警惕他人的情感操纵
process_en: Separate means from ends: split decisions into 'what to want' (the passions' jurisdiction) and 'how to get there' (reason's); forbid mutual trespass
Audit the factual layer: reason corrects only facts and means—check premises and routes without usurping judgment of ends
Face the sentiment: admit your goals spring from desire, not inference; make desire itself the object of scrutiny rather than hiding it
Persuade sentiment first: to change behavior, address feeling, desire, and identity before facts and logic
Tend the ecology of passion: desires are malleable—design your environment and narratives to cultivate good ones, and beware others' emotional manipulation
representative_cases_zh: 《人性论》'树屋'例：只想砍树搭屋的人不会因理性说'搭屋无用'而停手——理性只能指出'这棵树更快倒'之类的事实路径差异
休谟的政治写作术：《英格兰史》以叙事与人物塑造改写英国人的政治情感（同情托利的斯图亚特叙事）——不辩经而移情的历史说服范本
'理性纠错'的合法范围示范：投资者说'我要翻本所以加倍下注'，理性可以指出'加倍下注不减少你已亏的'（事实纠错），但不能宣判'翻本欲求不正当'（目的不可审）
他对宗教狂热的处理：《宗教的自然史》不辩'神存在与否'，而追'宗教激情从何演化'（恐惧与希望）——把神学问题转译为激情发生学
representative_cases_en: The tree-house case in the Treatise: a man who wants to fell a tree and build a hut is not stopped by reason declaring the hut useless—reason can only point out facts such as 'this tree falls faster'

Hume's political craft: the History of England rewrote the political sentiments of the English through narrative and characterization (a Tory-inflected Stuart story)—historical persuasion by moving feeling, not by disputation

The lawful scope of rational correction: an investor says 'I want to break even, so I double down'; reason may note that doubling down does not shrink the loss already booked (factual correction), but cannot declare the desire for breakeven illegitimate (ends are not audit-able)

His handling of religious enthusiasm: the Natural History of Religion does not dispute whether God exists but traces where religious passion evolved from (fear and hope)—translating theology into the genetics of passion
modern_applications_zh: 产品与营销：先做用户访谈挖掘欲求（激情层），再设计功能与文案（理性层）——'先痛点后方案'的休谟次序
公共政策：行为洞察团队（nudge unit）不与公民辩论'该不该储蓄'，而改造默认选项与框架——在情感层设计而非说教
谈判与沟通：利益分配僵局先处理情绪与面子，再谈数字——'先情感后条款'的谈判次序
自我管理：拖延不是信息问题而是欲求冲突——先安顿情感（降低启动阻力）再谈计划，与'提高意志力'相反
modern_applications_en: Product and marketing: mine desire in user research (the passion layer) before designing features and copy (the reason layer)—Hume's order of pain-point before solution
Public policy: behavioral insights teams do not debate citizens into saving; they redesign defaults and framing—designing at the sentiment layer rather than preaching
Negotiation: resolve deadlock over feelings and face before numbers—the order of sentiment before terms
Self-management: procrastination is a conflict of desire, not an information problem—settle the sentiment (lower the friction of starting) before planning, the opposite of 'raising willpower'

representative_figures.relation_zh: 挚友与传承者：《道德情操论》把'同情'发展为道德与经济的共同地基——激情限权法的体系化
representative_figures.relation_en: friend and inheritor: the Theory of Moral Sentiments makes sympathy the common ground of morals and economics—the systematized version

representative_figures.relation_zh: 谱系学同道：以'理性是激情的仆从'反攻理性主义传统——限权法的激进版本
representative_figures.relation_en: fellow genealogist: reason as the servant of passion, turned back against rationalism—the radicalized version

representative_figures.relation_zh: 实验传人：行为经济学证明人类决策由情感启发式主导——限权法的实证化
representative_figures.relation_en: experimental heir: behavioral economics demonstrated that decision is steered by affective heuristics—the empirical version

name_zh: 元方法/从'是'（事实陈述）推不出'应当'（价值结论）——价值断言必须单独给出其情感或规范前提
name_en: meta-method/no inference from 'is' (statements of fact) to 'ought' (conclusions of value)—every value claim must supply its sentiment or normative premise separately
category: 元方法/从'是'（事实陈述）推不出'应当'（价值结论）——价值断言必须单独给出其情感或规范前提
modes.domain_zh: 《人性论》卷三.1.1：'作者通常不是从'是'与'不是'推进到'应当'与'不应当'……这个转换虽极平凡，却值得被一次永远地指出'——哲学史上最著名的脚注
modes.domain_en: Treatise III.1.1: 'in every system of morality the author proceeds for a time as usual, when suddenly, instead of is and is not, he finds propositions joined with ought and ought not... this change, however imperceptible, is of the last consequence'—the most famous footnote in philosophy
modes.definition_zh: 这是伦理学史上最短也最致命的一段：休谟指出，所有道德体系的作者都会先陈述一串事实（'人是社会的动物''此行为增加幸福'），然后在某个无人察觉的瞬间，悄悄把'是'换成了'应当'——从'这个行为增加福祉'滑到'因此这个行为应当做'。可'应当'从不在前提里，它在结论里无中生有。深意在于三重：其一，事实与价值之间存在逻辑裂缝——无论堆多少事实，都推不出一个价值；价值结论必须有独立的规范性前提（某个被欲求的终点）。其二，这为道德的情感主义奠基：既然'应当'不来自事实推理，它来自何处？来自情感——道德判断是情感的表达而非事实的报道。其三，它是所有规范性学科的审计工具：法学的'从宪法条文推不出判决的价值裁量'、经济学的'从效率推不出分配的正义'、技术哲学的'从'能造'推不出'该造''，处处是这道裂缝的工作现场。代价：彻底执行会让规范性论证'显形'——所有价值主张都要亮出其情感底牌，这可能让公共讨论更诚实，也可能让'价值无客观根据'的相对主义趁虚而入；休谟本人以'人类情感的普遍结构'（同情是共同人性）来缓冲相对主义——情感的普遍性给了价值以主体间的稳固性。现代对应物：伦理学中的'开放问题论证'、法律解释学的'事实与规范二分'、科技伦理的'可做不等于该做'原则、以及一切'把隐藏价值前提提到桌面上'的批判性审查。
modes.definition_en: The shortest and deadliest passage in the history of ethics: Hume observes that authors of every system of morality state a run of facts ('man is a social animal,' 'this act increases welfare'), and then, in some moment no one notices, quietly swap is for ought—from 'this act increases welfare' to 'therefore it ought to be done.' The ought was never in the premises; it appears in the conclusion ex nihilo. Three layers of depth. First, a logical chasm separates fact from value—no heap of facts yields a value; a value conclusion needs an independent normative premise (some desired end). Second, this founds the sentimentalist account of morals: since ought comes not from factual inference, from where? From sentiment—moral judgment expresses feeling rather than reporting fact. Third, it is an audit instrument for every normative discipline: jurisprudence's 'the value judgment of a sentence cannot be deduced from the statute's text,' economics' 'efficiency does not entail distributive justice,' and technology ethics' 'can does not entail ought'—the chasm at work everywhere. The cost: enforced, it exposes every normative argument—value claims must show their sentiment cards—which makes public debate more honest but also opens the door to relativism ('values have no objective ground'); Hume himself buffers this with the universal structure of human feeling—sympathy as common human nature gives values intersubjective stability. Modern analogues: the open-question argument in ethics, the fact-norm dichotomy in legal hermeneutics, the 'possible does not mean permissible' principle in technology ethics—every critical review that surfaces hidden value premises.
modes.source_chapter: 《人性论》卷三.1.1（是-应当段落，'值得被一次永远地指出'）；卷三.1.2（道德区别源于情感而非理性）；《道德原则研究》附录一（道德感与理性的分工）
key_concepts: 事实与价值的逻辑裂缝
应当不能从是无中生有
modes.key_quote_zh: 从'是'到'应当'的那一步，人人都在跨，无人给出过桥费——请为你的'应当'单独付费。
modes.key_quote_en: Everyone crosses from is to ought; no one has ever paid the toll—pay for your ought separately.
process_zh: 标记过渡点：在论证中找出从事实陈述切换到价值断言的那个句子，显式圈出
盘点前提：检查'应当'是否真的从前提推出——通常它被偷偷写进了结论
索要规范前提：要求价值结论出示其独立的规范性前提（谁欲求什么、为什么）
审查情感底牌：识别该规范前提背后的情感或利益，确认其主体间可分享性
重建论证：把'是'部分与'应当'部分分层重写，各自用各自的凭证，不得混账
process_en: Mark the crossing: locate the sentence where factual statement switches to value assertion, and circle it
Audit the premises: check whether the ought truly follows—usually it has been smuggled into the conclusion
Demand the normative premise: require the value conclusion to show its independent normative premise—who desires what, and why
Inspect the sentiment card: identify the feeling or interest behind the normative premise and confirm its intersubjective shareability
Rebuild in layers: rewrite the is-part and the ought-part with separate credentials; no mingling of accounts
representative_cases_zh: '奴隶制自然论'的拆解：十八世纪流行'某些人天生适合被奴役'——休谟式的追问是：'天生的差异'（是）与'所以奴役正当'（应当）之间的过桥费从未被支付；他在《论奴隶制》随笔里干脆用历史事实（奴隶劳动的低效与暴行）反攻
《人性论》原文脚注的力量：一句'这个转换值得被一次永远地指出'，成为两个半世纪伦理学的分水岭——文献学史上最短的革命
功利主义内部的裂缝：'最大多数人的最大幸福'中，'幸福是可测量的'（是）与'应最大化它'（应当）之间，密尔被迫补写《功利主义》第五章作为情感过渡——裂缝从未真正弥合
技术伦理现场：'我们有能力用 X 做检测'（是）到'我们应该部署'（应当）之间，需要独立的价值前提（收益分配、同意、误差代价）——缺失即休谟违规
representative_cases_en: Dismantling the naturalness of slavery: the age's favorite premise 'some are born fit to be enslaved'—the Humean question is whether the toll was ever paid between 'natural difference' (is) and 'so slavery is just' (ought); in the essay Of the Populousness of Ancient Nations he attacks with historical facts: the inefficiency and atrocities of slave labor

The power of the Treatise's own footnote: one sentence—'this change is of the last consequence'—became the watershed of ethics for two and a half centuries; the shortest revolution in the history of footnotes

The crack inside utilitarianism: between 'happiness is measurable' (is) and 'it ought to be maximized' (ought), Mill was forced to write chapter five of Utilitarianism as the sentimental bridge—the crack never truly closed

Technology ethics in the field: between 'we can build X for detection' (is) and 'we should deploy it' (ought) stands an independent value premise—distribution of benefit, consent, the price of error; where it is missing, the Humean rule is violated
modern_applications_zh: AI 治理：'模型准确率 95%'（是）不构成'应上线'（应当）——上线论证必须补齐误差代价、公平性与同意等价值前提
法律写作：判决书把事实认定与规范评价分层（本院查明/本院认为），防止'从证据直接滑到定性'——是应当裂缝的程序化
商业伦理：'能赚钱'（是）到'该做此生意'（应当）之间，必须有独立价值审计（外部性、诚信成本）——ESG 即裂缝审计的制度化
公共辩论：识别对方论证中的'隐身应当'（'科学表明 X，所以应禁止 Y'），要求其出示规范前提——批判性思维的必修动作
modern_applications_en: AI governance: 'the model is 95% accurate' (is) does not entail 'deploy it' (ought)—deployment arguments must add value premises: the price of error, fairness, consent
Legal drafting: judgments separate fact-finding from normative evaluation (the court finds / the court holds), preventing the slide from evidence to characterization—the gap proceduralized

Business ethics: between 'it is profitable' (is) and 'we should be in this business' (ought) stands an independent value audit (externalities, the cost of integrity)—ESG as institutionalized gap-audit
Public debate: spot the opponent's invisible ought ('science shows X, so Y should be banned') and demand the normative premise—the mandatory move of critical thinking

representative_figures.relation_zh: 二十世纪重铸者：'自然主义谬误'与开放问题论证把休谟裂缝做成分析伦理学第一定理
representative_figures.relation_en: twentieth-century recaster: the naturalistic fallacy and the open-question argument made Hume's gap the first theorem of analytic ethics

representative_figures.relation_zh: 经济学内的守卫者：以'实证经济学与规范经济学必须分账'把裂缝制度化进福利经济学
representative_figures.relation_en: guardian within economics: positive and normative economics must keep separate accounts—the gap institutionalized in welfare economics

representative_figures.relation_zh: 社会科学的分账人：'价值判断悬置'原则是休谟裂缝在方法论上的社会学定装
representative_figures.relation_en: the accountant of social science: the suspension of value-judgment is the gap armed into sociological methodology

name_zh: 道德观/道德判断的引擎是同情——以想象共享他人感受、以旁观者视角校准自我评价；共情是可训练的社会技术
name_en: moral philosophy/the engine of moral judgment is sympathy—sharing others' feelings by imagination and calibrating self-regard from the spectator's view; empathy is a trainable social technology
category: 道德观/道德判断的引擎是同情——以想象共享他人感受、以旁观者视角校准自我评价；共情是可训练的社会技术
modes.domain_zh: 《人性论》卷二.1.11：'人心的镜子'——他人的情绪在心中唤起同一情绪的微弱摹本，如同琴弦共振；卷三.3.1 以'公正旁观者'校准自我
modes.domain_en: Treatise II.1.11, 'the mirror of minds'—another's emotion raises in us a fainter copy of the same emotion, like strings resonating in sympathy; III.3.1 calibrates the self against the impartial spectator
modes.definition_zh: 休谟道德心理学的核心装置是同情（sympathy）：他人的情绪通过表达（表情、声音、姿态）进入我的想象，在我心中唤起同一情绪的微弱摹本——如同两根弦的共振。道德赞许与谴责由此发生：当我分享你的感受，你的快乐成为我的快乐来源，我便赞许使你快乐的行为。深意有三重。其一，它把道德的根基从天命与理性移到共同人性：我们之所以能彼此评价，是因为人类心灵结构相同，共振机制人人皆有——道德有'客观性'，但那是主体间的客观性（普遍共振）而非天上的客观性。其二，它发明了'旁观者视角'作为自我评价的校准器：自我对自己的激情天然偏袒（近大远小），唯一矫正方法是想象一个不知情的公正旁观者怎么看——这是斯密《道德情操论》的起点，也是'道德作为社会镜子'传统的开端。其三，同情是技术不是天性：共振强度取决于沟通的带宽与联想的习惯——可以设计（接近性、相似性、叙事生动性都放大共振）。代价：同情随距离衰减——'整个世界的毁灭不如划破我的手指'的极端表述揭示了同情的半径问题，现代大规模道德（代际正义、全球贫困）恰在半径之外；休谟的补救是把同情升格为规则（普遍惯例），而非依赖每次的鲜活性。现代对应物：用户共情研究、叙事传播对捐款率的影响、司法的'旁观者检验'、组织文化的心理安全设计。
modes.definition_en: The central device of Hume's moral psychology is sympathy: another's emotion enters my imagination through its expression—face, voice, posture—and raises in me a fainter copy of the same emotion, as two strings resonate together. Moral praise and blame arise here: when I share your feeling, your joy becomes a source of mine, and I approve what makes you happy. Three layers of depth. First, it moves morality's foundation from heaven and reason to common human nature: we can judge one another because the structure of the human mind is everywhere the same and the resonating mechanism universal—morality has objectivity, but intersubjective objectivity (universal resonance), not celestial objectivity. Second, it invents the spectator's point of view as the calibrator of self-assessment: our own passions appear to us magnified by proximity, and the only correction is to imagine how an uninformed, impartial spectator would see us—the starting point of Smith's Theory of Moral Sentiments and of morality as social mirror. Third, sympathy is a technology, not a mere endowment: the strength of resonance depends on the bandwidth of communication and habits of association—it can be designed (proximity, similarity, and narrative vividness all amplify it). The cost: sympathy decays with distance—the extreme formula 'the ruin of millions is less than the cut of my finger' exposes the radius problem, and modern large-scale morality (intergenerational justice, global poverty) lies precisely beyond the radius; Hume's remedy is to upgrade sympathy into rules (general conventions) rather than rely on each occasion's vividness. Modern analogues: user-empathy research, narrative's effect on donation rates, the spectator test in adjudication, and the design of psychological safety in organizational culture.
modes.source_chapter: 《人性论》卷二.1.11（同情机制：人心的镜子）；卷二.2.5（同情对财产与正义的支撑）；卷三.3.1-3.3（旁观者视角与美德评价）；《道德原则研究》第五、九节
key_concepts: 道德赞许源于共享感受
modes.key_quote_zh: 人心的弦会共振——他人的悲欢在唤起我微弱的同一悲欢；道德就发生在这面镜子前。
modes.key_quote_en: The strings of the mind resonate—another's joy and grief raise in me a fainter copy of the same; and before this mirror morality happens.
process_zh: 开启共振：主动接触他人的表达（语言、数据之外的人的呈现），允许情绪摹本进入
描摹他心：以想象重建对方处境（处境重于语言），区分'我的投射'与'他的感受'
旁观校准：以'不知情公正旁观者'视角重审自己的行为与特权，矫正近大远小的自我滤镜
升格为规则：把个案共鸣凝结为普遍惯例（规则先于个案判断），以覆盖同情半径之外的情况
设计带宽：在组织与传播中制造接近性、相似性与叙事生动性，扩大共振的有效半径
process_en: Open the resonance: seek out others' expression—persons beyond words and data—and let the copies of feeling enter
Sketch the other mind: rebuild the situation by imagination (situation over language), separating my projection from their feeling
Calibrate with the spectator: review one's own conduct and privileges as an uninformed impartial spectator would, correcting the near-large-far-small self-lens
Ascend to rules: condense case-level resonance into general conventions—rules before case judgment—to cover what lies beyond sympathy's radius
Design the bandwidth: manufacture proximity, similarity, and narrative vividness in organization and communication to extend the effective radius
representative_cases_zh: 《人性论》卷二.1.11 的琴弦比喻：他人悲伤的表达在我心中唤起'较弱的悲伤摹本'——同情机制的物理学式表述，斯密整部《道德情操论》由此出发
休谟论'为什么我们能评价古人与异邦人'：共振不靠在场而靠人性结构的相同与叙事的传递——远距离道德的可能性论证
他对'近大远小'的自我矫正：休谟终身以'克制与礼法'约束自己的虚荣与自利（斯密讣告中'完全智慧与德性之人'的评语正源于此）——旁观者法的第一人称实践
《道德原则研究》的'有用性实验'：追问为何赞许公益设施（即便不在本国）——用思想实验证明同情以人类整体为最终半径
representative_cases_en: The strings metaphor of Treatise II.1.11: the expression of another's sorrow raises in me a weaker copy of sorrow—the physics-style statement of sympathy from which Smith's whole Theory of Moral Sentiments departs
His account of why we can judge ancients and foreigners: resonance needs not presence but the sameness of human structure carried by narrative—the argument for morality at a distance

His self-correction of near-large-far-small: lifelong 'restraint and politeness' disciplining his own vanity and self-interest (Smith's obituary 'approaching the perfectly wise and virtuous' testifies)—the spectator method in the first person
The utility experiment of the second Enquiry: why do we approve works of public benefit even outside our own country?—a thought experiment proving sympathy's ultimate radius is humanity as a whole
modern_applications_zh: 用户研究：访谈设计要求'重建处境'而非收集口头偏好——共振带宽的田野工程
传播与筹款：'具体的一个孩子'比'统计上的百万人'更能唤起行动——同情半径与叙事生动性的实证应用（及其'可识别受害者效应'伦理）
组织文化：制度化的'旁观者检验'（此决策若上报纸头条，读者如何看）——把公正旁观者装进决策流程
教育与领导力：共情训练（换位叙述、情境模拟）作为可课程化技能，而非天赋
modern_applications_en: User research: interviews must rebuild the situation rather than collect stated preferences—field engineering of resonance bandwidth
Communication and fundraising: 'one named child' moves action more than 'statistics of millions'—the empirical use of radius and vividness (with the identifiable-victim ethics it raises)
Organizational culture: the institutionalized spectator test (how would readers see this decision on the front page?)—the impartial spectator installed in the decision process
Education and leadership: empathy training (perspective narration, simulation) as a curriculum-able skill, not an endowment

representative_figures.relation_zh: 直接继承人：以'公正旁观者'为轴心建起《道德情操论》——同情共鸣法的完整展开
representative_figures.relation_en: direct heir: the impartial spectator as the axis of the Theory of Moral Sentiments—sympathy resonance fully unfolded

representative_figures.relation_zh: 演化重述者：《人类的由来》把同情解释为社会本能的演化产物——共振机制的生物学版本
representative_figures.relation_en: evolutionary restater: the Descent of Man explains sympathy as evolved social instinct—the biology of the resonance mechanism

representative_figures.relation_zh: 现代实验者：'可识别受害者效应'与'同情坍缩'（人数越多共情越少）实验地暴露了同情半径问题
representative_figures.relation_en: modern experimentalist: the identifiable-victim effect and psychic numbing expose the radius problem in the laboratory

name_zh: 制度观/正义、财产、承诺非自然之德而是人为之德——由共同利益感催生、经惯例固化的设计产物，可以再设计
name_en: institutional theory/justice, property, and promise are artificial, not natural virtues—designs born of common-interest sense and fixed by convention; therefore redesignable
category: 制度观/正义、财产、承诺非自然之德而是人为之德——由共同利益感催生、经惯例固化的设计产物，可以再设计
modes.domain_zh: 《人性论》卷三.2：正义'不是由自然写进人心的，而是人为的设计'；财产与承诺是'公共效用的惯例'——休谟是制度主义与博弈论社会契约观的直系祖先
modes.domain_en: Treatise III.2: justice is 'not derived from nature but from artifice'; property and promise are 'conventions of public utility'—Hume is the direct ancestor of institutionalism and the game-theoretic social contract
modes.definition_zh: 休谟对制度起源的洞察领先其时代两百年：正义与财产不是自然法给定的永恒结构，也不是理性推演的必然结论，而是'人为之德'（artificial virtues）——在物资有限、慷慨有限、利己无限的条件下，人们发现'普遍遵守稳定占有规则的系统收益大于各自为战的收益'，于是经反复互动自发生成惯例（先占、继受、长期占有），再由政府与教育加固为制度。他著名的两支划船类比：两只船在湖上相向而行，无需协议或承诺，仅凭对共同利益的预见即会各自靠边——惯例先于契约。深意在于：其一，这是社会契约理论的釜底抽薪——霍布斯与洛克为制度寻找一次性授权（原初契约），休谟指出没有哪代人真的签过字，制度的合法性来自'渐进累积的共同利益感'，来自它管用；其二，制度是涌现秩序而非顶层设计——秩序可以从自利互动中自发生长；其三（最革命的一步），既然是人为设计，就可以再设计：检验制度的标准是它是否仍服务共同利益，过时的惯例应被改革。这也是他对洛克社会契约论的著名批判（'服从政府与信守承诺的义务都基于共同利益，政府不是靠一张从未签署的合同'）。代价：惯例解释有保守倾向——'管用'的检验标准偏历史经验，对'现存制度不正义但尚未崩塌'的情形反应迟钝（休谟对当时英国政治结构的温和辩护因此常被批评）；且共同利益感依赖于'普遍遵守'的小前提，搭便车是惯例的天然病毒。现代对应物：博弈论的演化均衡、制度的路径依赖与改革设计、平台规则的自发生长与治理、以及一切'先问该惯例还服务共同利益吗'的制度审计。
modes.definition_en: Hume's insight into institutional origins ran two centuries ahead: justice and property are neither eternal structures given by natural law nor necessary conclusions of reason, but 'artificial virtues'—under conditions of moderate scarcity, limited generosity, and boundless self-interest, people discover that the systemic payoff of universally obeying stable possession rules exceeds that of each fighting for himself; conventions (first occupancy, succession, long possession) thus grow spontaneously through repeated interaction, then harden into institutions under government and education. His famous rowing-boat analogy: two boats approaching each other on a lake need no agreement or promise—each, by forethought of the common interest, keeps its own side; convention precedes contract. Three layers of depth. First, it undercuts social-contract theory—Hobbes and Locke sought a one-time authorization (the original contract), but Hume notes no generation ever signed; an institution's legitimacy comes from 'the gradually accumulated sense of common interest,' from its working. Second, institutions are emergent order, not top-down design—order can grow from self-interested interaction. Third, the most revolutionary step: being artificial, they are redesignable—the test of a convention is whether it still serves the common interest, and obsolete conventions ought to be reformed. It is also his famous critique of Locke: 'the obligation to obey government and to keep promises both rest on common interest; government is not founded on a contract never signed.' The cost: the convention account leans conservative—the test of 'works' privileges historical experience and reacts slowly to 'unjust but not yet collapsed' institutions (his mild defense of Britain's existing constitution is often criticized for this); and the sense of common interest depends on the minor premise of universal compliance, making free-riding the natural virus of conventions. Modern analogues: evolutionary equilibria in game theory, path dependence and institutional redesign, the spontaneous growth and governance of platform rules—every institutional audit that asks, first, does this convention still serve the common interest.
modes.source_chapter: 《人性论》卷三.2.2-2.10（正义与财产的惯例起源、两船类比、三占有规则）；卷三.2.4-2.5（承诺的人为性）；《道德原则研究》第三节（正义是有用的）
key_concepts: 惯例先于契约（两船类比）
modes.key_quote_zh: 两只相向而行的船无需签约便各自靠边——正义不是签出来的合同，而是长出来的惯例。
modes.key_quote_en: Two boats rowing toward each other keep to their sides without a treaty—justice is not a contract signed but a convention grown.
process_zh: 追起源：对任何'理所当然'的制度追问'它如何从互动中长出来'——找到它最初服务的共同利益
验前提：检查该制度赖以成立的条件（稀缺度、遵守率、执行成本）今天是否仍在
测效用：以'是否仍服务共同利益'为标准评估制度，而非'是否符合传统或演绎'，
识搭便车：找到制度中'人人希望别人遵守而自己例外'的漏洞及其扩散路径
再设计：对失效惯例设计最小扰动改革——承认其历史功能，以新惯例而非空降蓝图替换
process_en: Trace the origin: for any institution taken for granted, ask how it grew from interaction—which common interest it first served
Test the premises: check whether its founding conditions (scarcity, compliance rate, enforcement cost) still hold today
Measure the utility: evaluate the institution by whether it still serves the common interest, not by tradition or deduction
Locate free-riding: find where everyone hopes others comply while excepting themselves, and how the hole spreads
Redesign: reform failed conventions with minimal disturbance—honoring their historical function, replacing them with new conventions rather than parachuted blueprints
representative_cases_zh: 财产的三条占有规则：现占、先占、长期占有——休谟论证哪条都无'自然正当'，人们选中它们只因'稳定与简便'（可预测的裁判成本最低）——惯例选择的成本核算
两船类比（《人性论》卷三.2.2）：无需承诺与协定的协作自发生成——演化博弈论（如'聚点均衡'）的原型思想实验
对洛克社会契约论的批判：'历史上没有哪届政府是被同意建立的'——休谟在《论原始契约》随笔中指出服从的义务来自效用与惯例，此论直接动摇了美国革命者的理论武器（杰斐逊不得不绕道自然权利）
他在《政治论丛》对公债的警告：政府债务作为'人为惯例'若突破共同利益感（后代偿付意愿），将因信用崩塌而自我拆毁——制度可再设计的预警样本
representative_cases_en: The three rules of property—present possession, occupancy, long possession—none has 'natural right'; they were chosen for stability and convenience (the lowest adjudication cost): a cost accounting of convention choice
The rowing-boat analogy (Treatise III.2.2): cooperation generated without promise or agreement—the prototype thought experiment of evolutionary game theory and focal points

His critique of Locke's social contract: 'no government in history was founded on consent'—in the essay Of the Original Contract he locates the duty of obedience in utility and convention, discomfiting the American revolutionaries, who had to route around him via natural rights

His warning on the public debt in the Political Discourses: public credit as an artificial convention collapses when it outruns the sense of common interest (the willingness of posterity to pay)—an early specimen of redesignability warning
modern_applications_zh: 平台治理：社区规范不是法务起草的而是用户互动中长出来的——治理设计应'识别涌现惯例并加固'而非空降规则
国际关系：无世界政府的条件下，贸易与网络规范靠共同利益感维持——理解'退群'即共同利益感衰减的信号
组织制度：冗长审批流程若已背离其'防风险'初衷，应按'最小扰动再设计'重写而非增补补丁
公共品与搭便车：对'人人都等别人纳税/打疫苗'的惯例漏洞设计对冲（可见性、互惠结构）——博弈论政策设计
modern_applications_en: Platform governance: community norms grow from user interaction, not legal drafting—governance should identify emergent conventions and reinforce them, not parachute rules
International relations: without world government, trade and cyber norms rest on the sense of common interest—reading 'withdrawal' as the decay signal of that sense
Organizational process: when a lengthy approval flow has drifted from its original anti-risk purpose, rewrite it with minimal disturbance rather than patching endlessly
Public goods and free-riding: hedge the loophole of 'everyone waits for others to pay taxes or vaccinate' (visibility, reciprocity structures)—game-theoretic policy design

representative_figures.relation_zh: 自认直系后裔：'自发秩序'理论处处署名休谟——惯例演化与对建构理性的批判
representative_figures.relation_en: self-declared descendant: spontaneous order signed Hume everywhere—evolving conventions against constructivist rationalism

representative_figures.relation_zh: 博弈论复述者：《自然正义》以演化博弈重讲休谟的正义起源——惯例即均衡
representative_figures.relation_en: game-theoretic restater: Natural Justice retells Hume's origin of justice as evolutionary equilibria—convention as equilibrium

representative_figures.relation_zh: 深刻的对手：以《论人类不平等的起源》同样拆穿财产的制度性，却把休谟的'惯例'判为'枷锁'——改革的悲观版
representative_figures.relation_en: profound antagonist: the Second Discourse likewise unmasks property's artifice but convicts Hume's conventions as 'chains'—the pessimist's reform

name_zh: 认识论/证词的置信度永远不能超过'断言为假'的概率——越反常的主张需要越强的人证，且人证有上限
name_en: epistemology/testimony's credibility can never exceed the improbability of the claim—the stranger the assertion, the stronger the human evidence required, and human evidence has a ceiling
category: 认识论/证词的置信度永远不能超过'断言为假'的概率——越反常的主张需要越强的人证，且人证有上限
modes.domain_zh: 《人类理解研究》第十节'论奇迹'：'没有任何证词足以确立一个奇迹，除非该证词为假比该奇迹为真更不可思议'——先验概率对证词的封顶
modes.domain_en: Enquiry section X, 'Of Miracles': 'no testimony is sufficient to establish a miracle, unless the testimony be of such a kind, that its falsehood would be more miraculous than the fact which it endeavours to establish'—prior improbability capping testimony
modes.definition_zh: 这是贝叶斯推理在哲学史上的第一次系统运用：证据的力量等于'如果主张为真则出现此证据的概率'与'如果主张为假则出现此证据的概率'之比。奇迹（如死而复生）按齐一经验定义就是'迄今从未发生的事'，其先验概率极低；而证词来自人，人有说谎、受骗、记忆扭曲、被希望扭曲的记录——人证的可信度有硬上限。于是天平永远倒向一边：相信奇迹的证词所需的条件（证词为假的概率比奇迹为真更低）事实上无法满足。深意有三重。其一，这不是禁令而是天平：'越反常的主张需要越强的证据'是普遍的认知规则，不只针对宗教——超出范式的科学发现、爆炸性新闻、异常交易信号一律适用。其二，它把证据质量从'数量'中解放：十亿人转述同一奇迹，只是同一个源头的一封信被复印十亿次，证据是第一手信源的质量而非转发量。其三，他给出清单式的人证折扣因子：证人的数量与诚实度、表达与怀疑的对抗环境、 educators 的利益驱动、传达链的长度——每一项都可审计。代价：'齐一经验'本身来自归纳（与 M-UM-003 相连），若齐一性被豁免，奇迹的先验低概率就失去锚；且该规则在科学革命中要慎用——真正的新发现初始都'反常'，休谟式天平可能延迟对突破的采信（他的补救：突破靠的是可重复的实验而非孤证人证，门槛恰是这里说的'更強证据'）。现代对应物：贝叶斯检验中的先验权重、'非同寻常的主张需要非同寻常的证据'（萨根）、医学异常报告的复核阈值、反欺诈调查的证据标准。
modes.definition_en: The first systematic use of Bayesian reasoning in philosophy: the force of evidence equals the ratio of the probability of this evidence if the claim is true to its probability if the claim is false. A miracle—such as resurrection—is defined against uniform experience as 'what has never hitherto been observed,' so its prior probability is minimal; and testimony comes from humans, with a documented record of lying, being deceived, misremembering, and being swayed by hope—human credibility has a hard ceiling. The scales therefore always tip one way: the condition for believing miracle-testimony (that its falsehood would be more miraculous than the miracle's truth) is in fact unmeetable. Three layers of depth. First, this is not a ban but a balance: 'the stranger the claim, the stronger the evidence' is a universal cognitive rule, not aimed only at religion—paradigm-breaking discoveries, explosive news, anomalous trading signals all fall under it. Second, it frees evidence quality from quantity: a billion people repeating the same miracle is the same original letter photocopied a billion times; the evidence is the quality of the first-hand source, not the forward count. Third, he supplies a checklist of testimony-discount factors: the number and integrity of witnesses, the adversarial environment of expression and doubt, the interest of the educators, the length of the transmission chain—each auditable. The cost: 'uniform experience' itself rests on induction (joined to M-UM-003); if uniformity were waived, the miracle's low prior loses its anchor; and the rule must be applied cautiously in scientific revolutions—genuine breakthroughs are 'anomalous' at first, and a Humean balance may delay their acceptance (his remedy: breakthroughs rest on repeatable experiment, not lone testimony, which is exactly the 'stronger evidence'门槛 stated here). Modern analogues: prior weighting in Bayesian testing, Sagan's 'extraordinary claims require extraordinary evidence,' review thresholds for anomalous medical reports, and evidentiary standards in fraud investigation.
modes.source_chapter: 《人类理解研究》第十节（论奇迹：先验封顶与证词折扣清单）及第十一节（对实际宗教证词的清算）；《人性论》卷一.3.13（不可见理智的推理批判）
key_concepts: 证据质量独立于转发量
modes.key_quote_zh: 没有任何证词足以确立一个奇迹——除非这个证词为假，比它要证明的奇迹更奇迹。
modes.key_quote_en: No testimony is sufficient to establish a miracle—unless its falsehood would be more miraculous than the fact it endeavours to establish.
process_zh: 定先验：以迄今经验评估断言的基线概率——越偏离齐一经验，门槛越高
找源头：追溯证词的第一手信源（当事人/仪器/文档），转发量与信源质量分开记账
过折扣清单：审计证人数量、诚实度、对抗环境、利益驱动、传播链长度，逐项折减
算天平：只有当'证据为假'的概率低于'断言为真'的概率时才采信；算不出来就不采信
留复验口：若主张涉及重大利益，要求其转化为可重复检验（实验/数据）而非依赖孤证
process_en: Set the prior: assess the claim's baseline against experience hitherto—the further from uniform experience, the higher the bar
Find the source: trace testimony to its first-hand origin (persons, instruments, documents); book forward-count separately from source quality
Run the discount checklist: audit witness number, integrity, adversarial environment, interest, and transmission-chain length, item by item
Weigh the balance: accept only when the probability of the evidence being false is lower than that of the claim being true; if it cannot be computed, do not accept
Leave the replication gate: for high-stakes claims, require conversion into repeatable test (experiment, data) rather than reliance on a lone testimony
representative_cases_zh: 复活证的清算（《研究》第十节）：四个福音书的匿名转述者、相隔数十年、以殉道热情传播——休谟逐项过折扣清单，论证'证词为假'远非奇迹般不可能
朱维斯侯爵的'复活'骗局（1720s）：催眠暗示'死去的人'复活，目击者信誓旦旦——休谟引用它证明'证词与集体确信可以完全可靠地指向假'，人证上限的现场演示
他对通灵潮的解剖：《论奇迹》写作的直接背景是十八世纪的驱魔与预言热——'民族越迷信，奇迹证词越多'的反向相关正证'证词反映的是流行信念而非事件'
科学对照：彗星回归（哈雷预言）与海王星的发现不走证词之路而走可重复计算与观测——'更强证据'的正确形态是制度化的复验而非更响的证人
representative_cases_en: The audit of the resurrection (Enquiry X): four anonymous gospel transmitters, decades apart, driven by martyrdom ardor—Hume runs the discount checklist item by item, arguing the testimony's falsehood is anything but miracle-improbable

The Jansenist 'resurrection' at the tomb of the Abbé Paris (1720s): convulsionaries attested the dead raised; Hume cites it to prove testimony and collective certainty can point reliably at the false—a live demonstration of testimony's ceiling

His anatomy of the enthusiast wave: the essay's direct backdrop was eighteenth-century exorcism and prophecy mania—'the more superstitious the nation, the more its miracles' is the reverse correlation proving testimony mirrors belief, not events

The scientific contrast: Halley's comet returning on prediction, Neptune found by calculation—breakthroughs travel by repeatable computation and observation, not by louder witnesses; the right form of 'stronger evidence' is institutionalized replication
modern_applications_zh: 信息素养：病毒式'现场视频'先查第一手信源与转发链——'转发十亿次的一封信'仍是同一封信
投资尽调：对'颠覆性技术'的团队证词按利益驱动与可复验性折减，要求进入可测量的指标而非路演叙事
医学与科学出版：异常结果须通过独立复现（_registered replication）而非声明力度——奇迹证词法的期刊化
司法证据：传闻证据规则（hearsay rule）与'可疑辨认'的复核程序正是折扣清单的法律化身
modern_applications_en: Information literacy: for a viral 'on-site video,' audit the first-hand source and the transmission chain—a letter forwarded a billion times is still one letter
Investment diligence: discount team testimony on 'disruptive technology' by interest and testability; demand measurable metrics, not roadshow narrative
Medicine and scientific publishing: anomalous results must pass independent replication (registered replication), not assertive declarations—the miracle balance journalized
Legal evidence: the hearsay rule and review procedures for doubtful identifications are the discount checklist in law

representative_figures.relation_zh: 同代平行者：《机会的学说》给出先验与证据结合的形式工具——休谟天平的数学版
representative_figures.relation_en: contemporary parallel: An Essay towards Solving a Problem in the Doctrine of Chances supplied the formal tool of prior plus evidence—the mathematics of Hume's balance

representative_figures.relation_zh: 传播者：'非同寻常的主张需要非同寻常的证据'是奇迹证词法的科普化
representative_figures.relation_en: popularizer: 'extraordinary claims require extraordinary evidence' is the balance made public

representative_figures.relation_zh: 概率化完成者：以'证词的可靠度随断言的反常度衰减'把休谟论证写进《概率的分析理论》
representative_figures.relation_en: probabilistic finisher: testimony's credibility decays with the claim's improbability—the argument written into the Théorie analytique des probabilités

name_zh: 经济观/货币是流通的润滑油而非财富本身——货币量变动沿机制传导至价格与贸易，机制思维替代贵金属拜物教
name_en: economics/money is the oil of circulation, not wealth itself—changes in money's quantity transmit through mechanisms to prices and trade; mechanism-thinking displaces bullionist fetishism
category: 经济观/货币是流通的润滑油而非财富本身——货币量变动沿机制传导至价格与贸易，机制思维替代贵金属拜物教
modes.domain_zh: 《政治论丛》'论货币'：'货币不是商业的车轮，而是使车轮更平滑转动的油'——美洲金银流入欧洲物价上涨的机制分析，被视为数量论的奠基
modes.domain_en: Political Discourses, 'Of Money': 'money is not, properly speaking, one of the subjects of commerce; but only the instrument which men have agreed upon to facilitate the exchange'—the mechanism of American bullion raising European prices, the founding statement of the quantity theory
modes.definition_zh: 休谟 1752 年的《政治论丛》做了经济学史上一次范式转换：把'国家财富=囤积金银'的重商主义信条拆掉，代之以机制分析。核心命题：货币的绝对数量无关紧要，重要的是它的变动如何沿机制传导。两套机制：其一（货币数量论），货币量增加最终同比例提高物价，'其中必有中介环节'——他详细描述了传导的时间结构：新金银先流入特定人群，价格上涨逐行业扩散，工资最后调整，在过渡期产出与就业可能实际增加（正是后来凯恩斯主义'货币非中性'的先声）；其二（价格-铸币流动机制），贸易顺差流入金银，金银抬高国内物价，高物价削弱出口、吸引进口，逆差使金银回流——国际收支自动恢复平衡，因此'囤积金银的追求是自我挫败的'。深意在于：其一，他发明了'机制思维'的经济学范式——不问'应囤多少金银'（规范），先问'货币如何运转'（实然），整套古典经济学的实证气质由此开端；其二，传导的时间结构（滞后、扩散路径、过渡期效应）是他独到的贡献，使机制不是静态等式而是动态过程；其三，自我平衡机制的思想是'看不见的手'传统的一部分，也是现代国际收支理论的前身。代价：他的机制假设（工资最后调整、传导平滑）依赖较理想化的条件——现实中的刚性、预期与金融结构可使机制变形，这正是后来凯恩斯与货币主义各自修正的方向。现代对应物：中央银行的货币传导机制分析、实际汇率与国际收支调整模型、以及一切'追踪一个冲击如何沿链条传导并有时滞'的动态经济分析。
modes.definition_en: Hume's Political Discourses of 1752 performed a paradigm shift in the history of economics: dismantling the mercantilist creed that 'national wealth = hoarded bullion' and replacing it with mechanism analysis. The core proposition: the absolute quantity of money does not matter; what matters is how its changes transmit through mechanisms. Two mechanisms. First (the quantity theory), an increase in money finally raises prices proportionally, 'the progress is only gradual'—he traced the time structure: new bullion lands in particular hands, prices spread industry by industry, wages adjust last, and during the transition output and employment may genuinely rise (the first sounding of what Keynesians would call monetary non-neutrality). Second (the price-specie-flow mechanism), a trade surplus draws in bullion; bullion raises domestic prices; high prices weaken exports and invite imports; the deficit returns the bullion—international balances restore themselves, and the pursuit of hoarded treasure is self-defeating. Three layers of depth. First, he invented economics' paradigm of mechanism-thinking—not asking 'how much treasure should be hoarded' (norm), but 'how does money actually run' (is): the empirical temperament of classical economics begins here. Second, the temporal structure of transmission (lags, diffusion paths, transitional effects) is his distinctive contribution, making the mechanism a dynamic process rather than a static equation. Third, the idea of a self-balancing mechanism belongs to the tradition of the invisible hand and anticipates modern balance-of-payments theory. The cost: his mechanisms assumed rather idealized conditions—wages adjusting last, smooth transmission—whereas real rigidities, expectations, and financial structure can deform them, the very directions Keynes and later monetarists each corrected. Modern analogues: central-bank analysis of monetary transmission, real-exchange-rate and balance-of-payments adjustment models—every dynamic analysis that tracks how a shock travels a chain with lags.
modes.source_chapter: 《政治论丛》'论货币'（数量论与传导的渐进性）；'论贸易差额'（价格-铸币流动机制）；'论利息'（利息是商贸与利润的现象而非货币量的现象）
key_concepts: 货币是润滑油不是车轮
机制思维替代贵金属拜物教
modes.key_quote_zh: 货币不是商业的车轮，而是使车轮转动更顺滑的油——该问的不是囤多少，而是油如何流动。
modes.key_quote_en: Money is not the wheels of trade but the oil which renders the motion of the wheels more smooth and easy—ask not how much to hoard, but how the oil flows.
process_zh: 拆信条：把'X 是财富/坏处'类的重商式断言改写为'X 的变动如何沿机制传导'的机制问题
追踪传导：列出冲击落地的第一站人群、逐级扩散路径与各环节的时滞
析过渡期：区分长期均衡效应与过渡期效应——政策争议常在过渡期而非终点
找平衡阀：识别系统内的自我修正回路（如价格调整使顺差自我削弱）
标注失灵条件：说明何种刚性或预期会使机制变形——给机制结论附失效边界
process_en: Dismantle the creed: rewrite mercantilist assertions ('X is wealth / a curse') as mechanism questions—how changes in X transmit
Trace the transmission: name where the shock lands first, the path of diffusion industry by industry, and the lag at each link
Analyze the transition: distinguish long-run equilibrium effects from transitional effects—policy disputes usually live in the transition, not the terminus
Find the governor: identify the system's self-correcting loops (price adjustment that itself erodes the surplus)
State failure conditions: specify which rigidities or expectations would deform the mechanism—boundary conditions attached to mechanism conclusions
representative_cases_zh: 美洲金银的传导解剖：《政治论丛》描述新大陆金银如何先富特定人群、再逐行业抬高物价、最后工资跟涨——'在过渡期，工商业可能确实繁荣'——机制传导的时间结构首次被完整书写
价格-铸币流动机制：他论证'对贸易差额的恐惧与囤积金银的政策是自败的'——顺差自我侵蚀，被认为是国际收支自动平衡理论的开端，两百年后仍是国际经济学教科书基石
利息之论：'利息不是货币量的函数而是商贸利润的函数'——驳'降货币量即降利率'的直觉，显示机制分解如何纠正通俗经济学的表面相关
休谟与斯密的对话：斯密《国富论》的货币与贸易章节多处呼应《政治论丛》——机制思维从爱丁堡传到柯卡尔迪，古典经济学由此定调
representative_cases_en: The anatomy of American bullion: the Political Discourses traces how New World gold enriched particular hands first, raised prices industry by industry, and lifted wages last—'during the transition, industry and commerce may flourish'—the temporal structure of transmission written whole for the first time

The price-specie-flow mechanism: his argument that fear of the balance of trade and hoarding policies are self-defeating—the surplus erodes itself—regarded as the origin of automatic balance-of-payments adjustment, still a textbook cornerstone two centuries on

Of Interest: 'interest is a function of commercial profit, not of the quantity of money'—refuting the intuition that less money means lower rates, showing mechanism decomposition correcting surface correlation in popular economics

The Hume-Smith dialogue: the Wealth of Nations' chapters on money and trade echo the Discourses throughout—mechanism thinking passing from Edinburgh to Kirkcaldy, setting the tone of classical economics
modern_applications_zh: 货币政策解读：央行报告的'传导机制'章节（政策利率→信贷→投资→物价，各环时滞）正是休谟式追踪——解读'传导时滞'而非只看一次加息
汇率与资本流动：理解'顺差国货币升值侵蚀顺差'的自动调整逻辑，避免'囤储备是长久之计'的重商幻觉
企业财务：融资冲击（融资成本变动）沿'资金成本→投资决策→雇佣→定价'的传导与滞后——CFO 用机制思维排期而非应激反应
加密货币与货币史：'更多币≠更富'的数量论逻辑与传导路径分析，是评估币值实验的思想工具
modern_applications_en: Reading monetary policy: central-bank chapters on transmission (policy rate to credit to investment to prices, with lags at each link) are Humean tracking—read the lag, not the single rate hike
Exchange rates and capital flows: grasp the automatic logic of surplus-currency appreciation eroding the surplus, against the mercantilist illusion that hoarding reserves is a lasting plan
Corporate finance: a funding shock transmits along cost of capital to investment to hiring to pricing, with lags—the CFO schedules by mechanism rather than reacting
Cryptocurrency and monetary history: the quantity-theory logic that more units do not mean more wealth, plus transmission-path analysis, are the intellectual tools for assessing monetary experiments

representative_figures.relation_zh: 挚友与集大成者：《国富论》承接并体系化休谟的机制经济学——古典政治经济学的助产士关系
representative_figures.relation_en: friend and synthesizer: the Wealth of Nations receives and systematizes Hume's mechanism economics—the midwife relation of classical political economy

representative_figures.relation_zh: 形式化继承者：以纯理论把数量论与比较优势推至逻辑极点——机制思维的演绎化
representative_figures.relation_en: formalizing heir: pure theory pushed the quantity theory and comparative advantage to logical extremes—mechanism thinking made deductive

representative_figures.relation_zh: 过渡期修正者：以'货币非中性在短期'重提休谟的过渡期洞见——机制的时间结构得到宏观革命式重估
representative_figures.relation_en: corrector of the transition: monetary non-neutrality in the short run rediscovered Hume's transitional insight—the time structure of mechanism revalued by a macro revolution
